personal.name: Manav Mate
personal.headline: Product Manager & Early-Career Builder | AI Systems, PRDs & Operations

positioning.persona: Early-career tech product manager and former bootstrapped founder who transitioned from commercial ground operations to high-leverage AI product management. Proven ability to take 0-to-1 products from customer discovery to production delivery.
positioning.years_experience: 2-3 years across tech product management and bootstrapped founder operations

compensation.notes: Current CTC anchored at ₹8 LPA. Expected CTC targeted at ₹11 to ₹16 LPA based on company profile and role scope.

work_experience.context: Joined the founder early to own product discovery, PRDs, sprint planning, and core user journeys for an AI hiring intelligence platform.
achievements: Architected resume parsing/scoring pipeline ingesting 1,000 documents in under 10 minutes with 98% field extraction precision.
Cut model inference compute costs by 40% on Llama 3.1 via self-hosted microservices on NVIDIA NIM and strict JSON schema contracts.
Redesigned onboarding and screening funnels in Figma, lifting workflow completion by 30%.
Restructured platform monetization to a 5-tier freemium model supporting enterprise tiers up to ₹59,999/month.
Authored 14+ technical PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira, driving weekly sprint deliveries.

work_experience.context: Bootstrapped a commercial operations and B2B workforce business from zero without external venture capital.
achievements: Bootstrapped B2B workforce operations from zero to 50+ enterprise clients and 200+ on-ground projects across Mumbai.
Scheduled and directed field teams of up to 133 personnel across demanding multi-shift commercial exhibitions and live events.
Maintained 100% contractual SLA compliance across 200+ projects via standby buffers and a 15-minute emergency fill protocol.
Built standardized shift check-in rosters and QR audit tracking tools, reducing reconciliation cycles from 12 days to 48 hours.
Managed commercial contracts, vendor reconciliations, regulatory compliance, and working capital cash flows.

tone_rules.style: Early-career builder, founder-operator mindset, concise, outcome-oriented
forbidden_patterns: corporate buzzwords (spearheaded synergistic paradigms, leverage holistic cross-functional synergies)
robotic cover letter openings (I am writing to express my enthusiasm, My name is...)
fabricated corporate tenures or claiming 10+ years of corporate enterprise PM experience
tone_rules.required_framing: Emphasize hands-on technical product execution (PRDs, Llama 3.1 cost reduction, NVIDIA NIM, EvalGuard AI, SQL funnel analysis) backed by real-world operational grit (NeoManpower 50+ B2B clients, 133 personnel, zero SLA breaches).
